estimand: unweighted mean of net_pnl_cents/contracts on admitted PRIMARY_EX_ANTE trades
procedure: Resample clusters with replacement. For each draw compute T*. Studentize the centered draw (T* - T) / se*. The observed statistic is T / se. The one-sided p-value is the share of studentized centered draws at least as large as the observed studentized statistic, with the usual +1 numerator and +1 denominator. This is not the share of uncentered bootstrap means that are <= 0.
holm: only across the primary family members that returned a numeric p-value
